sentences.text:
Md. Danish Nishar & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on
3 February, 2026
03.02.2026
Court No.30
Item No.43
Sudipta
 Crr 3202 of 2025
 Md. Danish Nishar & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Moyukh Mukherjee
 Ms. Sarmistha Basak
 Mr. shakti Shivam
 ...for the petitioner.

Mr. Sobhan Gani
 ...for the opposite party no.2.
 1.

The revisional application has been preferred praying for quashing of the First Information Report,
in Ekbalpore Police Station Case No. 91 of 2025 dated 08.03.2025 under Sections 498A / 406 / 34
of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending
before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate at Alipore.
2.  The petitioners and the opposite party no. 2 are represented and they submit that the dispute has been amicably settled between the parties.
3. Learned counsel for the de facto complainant undertakes to file the vokalatnama in the department in course of this day.

4. Petitioners to serve upon the State.
5.
Let the matter be placed before the Regular Bench for hearing.

6. Pending hearing of the revisional application, the proceeding in Ekbalpore Police Station Case No. 91 of 2025 dated 08.03.2025 under Sections 498A / 406 / 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860,
read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate at Alipore be stayed till 22nd April, 2026 or until further order, whichever is earlier.
